ring: Reference: 14K Gold Ring Weight Chart by Size & Width (Comfort Fit)
note: NOT A PRODUCT — REFERENCE DATA ONLY. deBebians publishes an industry reference weight chart for 14K comfort fit wedding bands. For size 4: 2mm=1.4g, 3mm=2.6g, 4mm=3.8g, 5mm=5.3g, 6mm=5.5g. For size 5: 2mm=1.5g, 3mm=2.7g, 4mm=3.9g, 5mm=5.4g, 6mm=6.1g. Size 4.5 would be interpolated between these values. Useful as a sanity check when sellers do not publish weight.
